functions.name: Morning blessing
functions.notes: Family only; at home or a place of worship, as the family prefers.

highLevelTasks.title: Book the party venue or confirm the home setup
Order the cake and confirm candles and knife
Choose a theme and book décor
Plan games and book an entertainer if needed
Buy return gifts for every guest

rationale: A family blessing in the morning and one evening party keep the day simple. Catering and venue take most of the budget; return gifts matter because every guest gets one.
